I purchased my puppy from Mike. In March but i spoke with him countless times for weeks. I spend countless months looking for the perfect Standard American Bully Breeder and Mike is 100% the BEST there is. He was very patient with me and extremely informative. We answers and supports all of my needs before and after my purchase. He encouraged me to visit his facility before any kind of deposit or purchase to insure that i was 100% confident in my purchase. Thank you, Mike, for such a great experience!
